title: BrowserResolutionReason
description: Why a run's browser resolved as it did: chosen (the session's field named it), default (the field chose none, and the run takes the environment's headless browser), unattended (nobody is present, so a Chrome or the dock the field named resolves to none), headless-not-allowed (browser.headless.allowRuns is off), or headless-unavailable (the field chose none and the environment has no headless browser).
